_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Watch companies for new and closed roles...

description:
Best for: following companies over time, such as "watch Stripe and Ramp and tell me about new roles".
Returns: a watch_key, then on later calls the roles opened and closed since the last call (up to 100 of each listed, all counted). The first call is a baseline: it records the open roles and reports none as new.
Input tips: {"companies": ["greenhouse:airbnb", "lever:spotify"]} to start; {"watch_key": "hs_..."} to check, plus companies to add (at most 25).
Not for: a one-off look at one company (use company_hiring_brief).

companies.description: Careers page URLs, "ats:slug" tokens or company names, such as ["greenhouse:airbnb", "https://jobs.lever.co/spotify"]. Added to the watch.

watch_key.description: The watch_key an earlier call returned. Leave it out to start a new watch.

name: watch_new_roles

api_version.description: Date of this answer's shape; it changes only when a field is removed or changes meaning.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

baseline.description: True on a watch's first read: every open role is recorded and none is reported as new. A company added later is recorded the same way on its first read.

since.description: When the watch was last read.

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

watch_key.description: Keep it: it is the only way to read this watch again. Calls with it return changes since the last call.

title: Watch companies for new and closed roles
